description: Svelte deep state read through aliases (docs/design/REACTIVITY-ALIASING.md, R1/R2): a $state object set as a context (string key) and read through a constant, a constant of that constant, a $state.raw, a class instance's plain field, a Map value, a plain array iterated by {#each}, derived values and a function; clicks mutate it through its owner (a count and an array's length) and every reader updates. Before the fix natively every reader but the owner stayed at 0.
